input.ticket_text: I've been locked out of my account after too many failed password attempts. Can you help me get back in?
I need access to the finance dashboard for my new role but I keep getting an access denied error.
My Power BI sales report has been blank all morning and the dataset refresh keeps failing.
The nightly report query has been timing out for the past two days — is the database okay?
The customer count in this week's report doesn't match last week's — looks like there are duplicate records.
How do I export a Power BI report to PDF? Is that even possible?
Something is wrong with everything and nothing makes sense anymore, please just fix it.
